clusters.title: AI keyword clusters
clusters.description: Group 10–200 of your stored phrases into topics with one AI pass. The AI reads only rows you already fetched — it never calls the search vendor.
clusters.noCandidates: No stored phrases yet. Run keyword research first — clustering reads your stored rows.
clusters.disclosureUnit: One clustering pass uses one AI summary unit.
clusters.disclosureRerunFree: Running the exact same selection again is free — it returns the stored run.
clusters.remainingAllowance: {{remaining}} of {{cap}} AI summaries left this month
clusters.allowanceUnknown: Your remaining allowance could not be loaded. The server still checks it before running.
clusters.runningStatus: The AI pass is running. This usually takes a few seconds — no percentage is shown because the model does not report one.
clusters.runFailed: Could not run the clustering pass.
clusters.listFailed: Could not load stored clustering runs.
clusters.detailFailed: Could not load that clustering run.
clusters.evidenceOnlyTitle: The AI pass finished without clusters
clusters.evidenceOnlyBody: Your stored rows were validated but the model returned no topic groups this time. Your evidence is untouched — this does not mean no topics exist.
clusters.noFilterMatch: No clusters match the current decision filter.
clusters.confidenceNote: Confidence is computed deterministically from member count and intent homogeneity — the AI suggests the grouping; the label is not an AI score.
clusters.acceptBody: Accepting creates one Content Intelligence recommendation on the site you choose. Decisions are recorded once and cannot be flipped later.
clusters.sitesEmpty: You have no sites yet. Add a site first to accept a cluster.
clusters.replayHint: This cluster is already accepted. The links below open the existing destination — repeating the decision does not create a second recommendation.
clusters.dismissBody: Dismissing is final for this cluster — the decision log is append-only and cannot be flipped later.
